subject: Using Shiny to write a GUI for SQL search

messages.author: 7e6f8acb39323fe9
messages.subject: Using Shiny to write a GUI for SQL search
parts:
Hi guys,

I am trying to integrate RMySQL into a GUI using Shiny.

Below is my server.R code:
===
require(shiny)
require(RMySQL)

driver <- dbDriver("MySQL")
connection <- dbConnect(MySQL(), user="fgl", host="localhost", password="fgl",dbname="fgl")
#genotype <- read.csv(genotype.csv) #read in genotype excel spreadsheet as csv for export to mySQL
#dbWriteTable(connection, "genotypes", genotype)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize=-1)
shinyServer(function(input,output){
              statement <- reactive({
              x <- input$SNP
              y <- input$haplotype
             sprintf("SELECT IID, %s FROM genotypes WHERE %s = '%s'",x,x,y)
            })
              
              output$result <- renderTable(dbGetQuery(connection, statement()))
              }
            )
===

and my UI.R code:
===
require(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Integrated search interface for gene queries"),

  sidebarPanel(
    textInput("SNP", "rs ID of SNP of interest"),
    textInput("haplotype", "Genotype of rs ID"),
    helpText("separate genotype with a space (e.g. A A)"),
    submitButton("Submit")
    ), #end sidebar
  mainPanel(
     tableOutput("result") 
    )
  )#end pageWithSideBar
        ) #end shinyUI
===

However, even without any input into the text fields, upon keying runApp(), the following error messages are returned: 

Warning in if (!is.na(attribValue)) { :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used
Warning in if (!grepl(pattern, text)) return(text) :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used
Error in exists(key, where = .values, inherits = FALSE) : 
  variable names are limited to 10000 bytes

Am I doing something wrong here?

parts:
Hi guys,

I managed to solve this problem. 

UI.R
--

require(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Integrated search interface for gene queries"),

  sidebarPanel(
    textInput("SNP", "rs ID of SNP of interest"),
    textInput("haplotype", "Genotype of rs ID"),
    helpText("separate genotype with a space (e.g. A A)"),
textInput("number", "Number of samples needed (in descending order of stock)"),

require(shiny)
require(RMySQL)

driver <- dbDriver("MySQL")
connection <- dbConnect(MySQL(), user="fgl", host="localhost", password="fgl",dbname="fgl")
#genotype <- read.csv(genotype.csv) #read in genotype excel spreadsheet as csv for export to mySQL
#dbWriteTable(connection, "genotypes", genotype)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize=-1)
shinyServer(function(input,output){
  statement<- reactive({

sprintf("SELECT IID, %s FROM genotypes WHERE %s = '%s'",x,x,y)
           })

resultSamples <-reactive(dbGetQuery(connection, statement()))
            
  
             checkSurvey <-dbGetQuery(connection,"SELECT Sample_ID,  Stock_DNA__ul_ ,Amp_DNA_conc__ng_ul_  , Amp_DNA__ul_  FROM survey")
             resultStocks <- reactive({
               z <- as.character(input$number)
               a <- checkSurvey[checkSurvey$Sample_ID %in% resultSamples()$IID,]
               b <- a[order(-a$Stock_DNA__ul_),]
               c <- b[1:z,]
             })

             output$outputResults <- renderTable(resultStocks())
      
              }
          
            )
--

Thanks again for your time! 

Jeremy
